errors.evidence: The range on the horizontal axis is from 2⁰ to 2¹⁰, not from 2³ to 2¹⁰.
The vertical axis label is '频数（框架数）' (Frequency (number of frames)), but the description omits the parenthetical part '（框架数）'.

errors.text_span: 最大的柱状图位于水平轴的起始位置(2³)
errors.evidence: The largest bar is located at the 2⁰ position on the horizontal axis, not 2³.
The tallest bar, which is at position 2⁰, has a height of approximately 49. The bar at 2³ has a height of about 10. Neither is 53.

errors.text_span: 后续的柱状图高度逐渐降低
errors.evidence: The height of the bars does not gradually decrease after the first one. For example, the bar at 2² (height ~17) is taller than the bar at 2¹ (height ~12), and the bar at 2⁴ (height ~15) is taller than the bar at 2³ (height ~10).

errors.text_span: 这条曲线从柱状图的左侧起始，接近水平轴，在x轴2³处达到一个峰值
errors.evidence: The description of the red curve is incorrect. It starts at a high point (y > 50), far from the horizontal axis, and it is monotonically decreasing. It does not have a peak at x=2³ or anywhere else.
